<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="第 1 页" id="MoXOEyHBXv0V-0v77CGx"> <mxGraphModel dx="9785" dy="6005" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 %% 全局精细化样式定义
 classDef layer-client fill:#E8F4FF,stroke:#1890FF,stroke-width:2px,rounded:6px
 classDef layer-gateway fill:#F0F8FF,stroke:#13C2C2,stroke-width:2px,rounded:6px
 classDef layer-security fill:#FFF2F2,stroke:#F53F3F,stroke-width:2px,rounded:6px
 classDef layer-exec fill:#F6FFED,stroke:#52C41A,stroke-width:2px,rounded:6px
 classDef layer-session fill:#FFF7E6,stroke:#FAAD14,stroke-width:2px,rounded:6px
 classDef layer-core fill:#F9F0FF,stroke:#9254DE,stroke-width:2px,rounded:6px
 classDef layer-reply fill:#E6FFFB,stroke:#36CFC9,stroke-width:2px,rounded:6px
 classDef layer-infra fill:#F2F3F5,stroke:#86909C,stroke-width:2px,rounded:6px
 classDef layer-monitor fill:#FFF1F0,stroke:#FF7875,stroke-width:2px,rounded:6px
 classDef pass fill:#D9F7BE,stroke:#239B56,stroke-width:1.5px,rounded:4px
 classDef reject fill:#FFE8E6,stroke:#CF1322,stroke-width:1.5px,rounded:4px

 %% ① 客户端层
 subgraph L1[\"① 客户端层｜用户请求入口\"]
 direction LR
 C1[\"企微好友会话<br/>顾客添加店员发起对话\"]
 C2[\"企微客服入口<br/>扫码/链接进入会话\"]
 end
 class L1 layer-client

 %% ② 接入层
 subgraph L2[\"② 接入层｜回调安全预处理\"]
 direction LR
 G1[\"签名校验<br/>拦截伪造请求\"]
 G2[\"AES解密<br/>还原消息载荷\"]
 G3[\"MsgId去重<br/>接口幂等防护\"]
 G4[\"多店路由<br/>智能分发门店\"]
 G5[\"注入shop_id<br/>全局身份溯源\"]
 end
 class L2 layer-gateway

 %% ③ 防护层
 subgraph L3[\"③ 防护层｜限流 + 风控 + 意图过滤\"]
 direction LR
 S1[\"三层限流<br/>用户/门店/全局管控\"]
 S2[\"输入预检<br/>拦截空/超长/特殊字符\"]
 S3[\"qwen-flash分类<br/>区分预约/闲聊/违规\"]
 S4{\"业务意图判定\"}
 S5[\"✅ 合法预约<br/>放行\"]:::pass
 S6[\"❌ 非法内容<br/>拦截\"]:::reject
 
 S1 --> S2 --> S3 --> S4
 S4 --> S5
 S4 --> S6
 end
 class L3 layer-security

 %% ④ 执行层
 subgraph L4[\"④ 执行层｜LLM并发调度与容错\"]
 direction LR
 E1[\"Channel削峰队列<br/>异步解耦流量\"]
 E2[\"Worker工作池<br/>限制LLM最大并发\"]
 E3[\"Panic隔离<br/>单任务故障不雪崩\"]
 E4[\"超时熔断<br/>Context超时控制\"]
 E5[\"负载判定<br/>满载繁忙/空闲下发\"]
 
 S5 --> E1 --> E2 --> E3 --> E4 --> E5
 end
 class L4 layer-exec

 %% ⑤ 会话层
 subgraph L5[\"⑤ 会话层｜对话状态与上下文维护\"]
 direction LR
 SE1[\"双维度会话隔离<br/>顾客ID+门店ID\"]
 SE2[\"Redis List存储<br/>留存对话历史\"]
 SE3[\"3轮触发摘要<br/>精简冗余Token\"]
 SE4[\"qwen-flash摘要<br/>保留核心诉求\"]
 SE5[\"敏感词+鉴权<br/>实时内容防护\"]
 SE6[\"可信上下文注入<br/>防客户端篡改\"]
 
 E5 --> SE1 --> SE2 --> SE3 --> SE4 --> SE5 --> SE6
 end
 class L5 layer-session

 %% ⑥ 核心Agent层
 subgraph L6[\"⑥ 核心层｜Agent智能引擎 & 数据一致性\"]
 direction LR
 CO1[\"DeepSeek-V3<br/>高精度意图识别\"]
 CO2[\"智能工具规划<br/>自动匹配业务能力\"]
 CO3[\"四级模型降级<br/>全链路容错兜底\"]
 CO4[\"工具白名单<br/>越权拦截管控\"]
 CO5[\"查询工具组<br/>排班/技师/服务查询\"]
 CO6[\"交易工具组<br/>创建/取消预约\"]
 CO7[\"人工兜底组<br/>投诉/退款转接\"]
 CO8[\"MySQL事务<br/>业务原子一致性\"]
 CO9[\"Redis分布式锁<br/>防撞约超约\"]
 CO10[\"qwen-flash润色<br/>口语化场景回复\"]
 
 SE6 --> CO1 --> CO2 --> CO3 --> CO4 --> CO5 & CO6 & CO7 --> CO8 & CO9 --> CO10
 end
 class L6 layer-core

 %% ⑦ 回复层
 subgraph L7[\"⑦ 回复层｜多渠道消息出口\"]
 direction LR
 R1[\"会话渠道自动适配\"]
 R2[\"企微好友API回复\"]
 R3[\"企微客服API回复\"]
 
 CO10 --> R1 --> R2 & R3
 end
 class L7 layer-reply

 %% ⑧ 基础设施与容灾
 subgraph L8[\"⑧ 基础设施｜存储 & 容灾降级体系\"]
 direction LR
 INF1[\"MySQL主从<br/>读写分离架构\"]
 INF2[\"Redis核心能力<br/>限流/锁/缓存\"]
 INF3[\"Redis心跳探测<br/>定时健康Ping\"]
 INF4{\"熔断器状态判定\"}
 INF5[\"熔断开启<br/>只读降级模式\"]
 INF6[\"熔断恢复<br/>正常读写回归\"]
 INF7[\"限流兜底<br/>本地令牌桶降级\"]
 INF8[\"锁兜底<br/>MySQL唯一索引\"]
 INF9[\"缓存兜底<br/>直查MySQL降级\"]
 INF10[\"熔断状态<br/>飞书自动告警\"]
 end
 class L8 layer-infra

 %% ⑨ 可观测性
 subgraph L9[\"⑨ 可观测性｜全链路监控告警\"]
 direction LR
 M1[\"Prometheus<br/>全维度指标采集\"]
 M2[\"ELK/Loki<br/>全链路日志聚合\"]
 M3[\"飞书告警<br/>异常实时推送\"]
 end
 class L9 layer-monitor

 %% ========== 顶层主业务链路（新增） ==========
 L1 --> L2
 L2 --> L3

 L2 -.-> L9
